Strategy: Small items of size 25 or less go to the emptiest bin, while larger items use Best Fit, so the size of the item flips the preferred bin. The ranking differs from Best Fit only for small items. It may help by keeping tight bins available for large items that need them, or fail because small items scattered into empty bins can strand capacity across many bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(r if item <= 25 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
